description: This Kotlin class defines an Android activity for a tic-tac-toe game scoreboard. It manages displaying and resetting game scores, updating UI components, and providing accessibility announcements.

classes.name: ScoreboardActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays the scoreboard for a tic-tac-toe game, allowing users to view and reset scores, with accessibility support.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures UI components and button actions.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the scores display when returning to the activity.

methods.name: onNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles navigation up action, finishing the activity.

methods.name: renderScores
methods.description: Updates the score display and announces changes if specified.
